messages:
maria: Hey team — running into a 400 when invoking the PDF tool via function calling. Error says: "tool args: invalid JSON". Repro below, might be escaping related.

alex: Can you paste the exact payload you sent?

maria: Here you go (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gpt-pdf","input":"Summarize file","tool": "convert_pdf","tool_args": "{\"path\": \"C:\\\\Users\Maria\\Documents\report.pdf\",}"}'
```

sam: I see two obvious issues: tool_args is a string containing JSON (double-encoded) and there's a trailing comma after the path field. Also Windows backslashes are unescaped inside the string.

maria: Right — client is double-stringifying the args. But the SDK used to accept that pattern for other endpoints, surprised this rejects it.

alex: The tool/function call schema expects tool_args to be an object (JSON), not a serialized string. Example we expect: ""tool_args": {"path":"C:\Users\Maria\Documents\report.pdf"}". Note the double backslashes inside JSON literal.

maria: Tried that and still got 400. Here's the corrected body I used: 
```json
{"model":"gpt-pdf","input":"Summarize file","tool":"convert_pdf","tool_args":{"path":"C:\Users\Maria\Documents\report.pdf"}}
```

maria: Response: `{"error":{"message":"tool args schema mismatch: unexpected trailing comma at line 1","code":"INVALID_TOOL_ARGS"}}`

sam: Huh — error references trailing comma but your payload doesn't have one. Can you capture the raw bytes arriving at our gateway? Maybe a proxy is appending or a client lib bug.

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-8192 created and attached to this thread. Priority: P2.

maria: I grabbed a tcpdump at the client machine. Raw payload (hex->utf8):
```
{"model":"gpt-pdf","input":"Summarize file","tool":"convert_pdf","tool_args":{"path":"C:\Users\Maria\Documents\report.pdf",}}
```

alex: There it is — the trailing comma is present in the raw bytes. So the client stack is adding a comma when serializing. What language and lib?

maria: Node 14, they use a small helper that builds the JSON string via concat. I'll ping them. @sam any server-side tolerances we can add? This used to be lenient for some other endpoints.

sam: We intentionally tightened the tool arg parser to reject trailing commas for security/consistency reasons last quarter (ENG-ML change). It looks like that rollout might be why this now errors. We shouldn't auto-correct malformed JSON — better to surface clear error.

maria: Understood. Customer impacted is on Dedicated. They're blocked for a daily batch job. Can eng-ml confirm the change and whether there's a quick mitigation (fallback to lenient parser for legacy clients)?

eng-ml: Hi — confirmed: change id 2024-09-13T03 removed tolerant parsing for tool args. We can add a temporary fallback flag on the gateway to accept trailing-comma variants for a short window. Would need ops help to flip on per-customer.

maria: Customer is okay with a temporary toggle. Can we do per-customer toggle rather than global? They don't want other callers affected.

sam: Ops: we can add a header `X-Redwood-ToolArgs-Lenient: support-8192` that enables lenient parsing for requests with that header. Requires a canary deploy to Dedicated pool for the tenant.

support-bot: Escalation steps recorded in SUP-8192. Assigning to eng-ml and eng-sre.

alex: Meanwhile, share a quick mitigation with the customer: update client to build tool_args as JSON (not string) and remove trailing commas. Example snippet (Node):
```js
const payload = {
  model: 'gpt-pdf',
  input: 'Summarize file',
  tool: 'convert_pdf',
  tool_args: { path: 'C:\Users\Maria\Documents\report.pdf' }
};
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type':'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```

maria: I'll send that to the customer and request they try the encoded object. Also requesting ops to enable the lenient header for SUP-8192 while client updates.

sam: Sounds good. If we enable the header, let's also add a short audit log so we can flip it off after one week.

maria: Noted. Will update SUP-8192 with customer's acceptance. Thanks all :thumbsup:

eng-ml: Follow-up: adding a small validation error message improvement so future 400s say "trailing comma detected in tool_args". Will post PR link shortly.

maria: Thanks — closing loop once ops confirms header toggle.
